tags.chapter_name: Classification of Elements and Periodicity in Properties

question.text: The element that does not show catenation is

solution.text: Catenation is the tendency to link with one another through covalent bonds to form chain and rings, i.e., catenation. This is because bonds are very strong in the carbon family. On moving down the group, the size increases and the tendency to show catenation decreases because bond enthalpy decreases. The order of catenation is <math xmlns="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML"><mi mathvariant="normal">C</mi><mo>></mo><mi>Si</mi><mo>></mo><mi>Ge</mi><mo>></mo><mi>Pb</mi></math>. <math xmlns="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML"><mi>Pb</mi></math> does not show catenation.
